title: Injectivity of the matching-to-permutation map
statement: For every natural number $m$, the map sending a perfect matching of the complete graph on $2m$ vertices to the permutation that exchanges the two vertices in each matched pair is injective. Its image consists of permutations whose cycle decomposition has exactly $m$ cycles of length $2$.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is the complete graph on 2m vertices
The input is a perfect matching
